Title: Simulated pad status is presented as live hardware
Description: The BLE driver initializes connected=true, battery=94 and weight=842g without connecting to hardware. The status API returns connected=true and the dashboard maps it to Live Connected.
Steps to reproduce: Start backend without verified pad; GET /api/v1/device/status; inspect SmartDiningPadBLE.__init__ and HomeDashboardScreen connection label.
Expected result: Simulation is explicitly labeled, or absent hardware reports disconnected/unavailable.
Actual result: HTTP response reports connected=true, battery=94 and Active HX711 from hardcoded driver values.
Root cause: BLE class is an in-memory simulator with connected=true default and no physical BLE connection check.
Fix applied: None; hardware semantics require product decision and device integration.

Title: Preloaded and error fallback meal values appeared as analysis
Description: The provider preloaded a fixed meal, 486 g and 94% confidence. A failure branch also inserted fixed components and 85% confidence.
Steps to reproduce: Open active session before photo; observe fixed dish and 94% confidence; inspect provider initial and exception branches.
Expected result: Error state or clearly labeled simulation, with no inferred nutrition presented as measured analysis.
Actual result: Initial browser session showed Vegetable Rice Bowl and 94% confidence before any photo at 0 g.
Root cause: Provider constructor initialized fixed meal values; catch branch replaced failures with fixed components.
Fix applied: Removed preloaded meal and static error fallback; active session waits for photo; fallback is labeled Catalog Estimate.
Retest result: PASS: active session showed Awaiting Meal Photo and 0 g; final browser screenshot saved.

Title: Web image upload used unsupported dart:io multipart path
Description: On Flutter Web, MultipartFile.fromPath failed because dart:io was unavailable.
Steps to reproduce: Log in; choose a synthetic JPEG from gallery; observe upload failure.
Expected result: JPEG preview and authenticated multipart upload should succeed.
Actual result: Browser displayed Unsupported operation: MultipartFile is only supported where dart:io is available.
Root cause: API service used MultipartFile.fromPath with a dart:io File on web.
Fix applied: Use XFile bytes and MultipartFile.fromBytes with explicit image MIME; render preview from bytes.
Retest result: PASS: synthetic image preview rendered and backend stored an uploaded JPEG.

Title: Image analysis client timed out before usable backend result
Description: Initial browser upload reached backend but UI reported vision service unavailable; direct analysis returned HTTP 200 with a catalog result.
Steps to reproduce: Upload synthetic JPEG; compare browser response with direct authenticated analysis request.
Expected result: The browser should wait for image analysis and show the returned result with provenance.
Actual result: Initial UI reported unavailable; direct API completed in 1.84 s; a 3 s shared client timeout was present.
Root cause: Image analysis shared a short 3 s timeout with simple POST actions.
Fix applied: Set a 30 s timeout only for vision analysis and label catalog fallback in the UI.
Retest result: PASS: browser displayed 500 g Vegetable Rice Bowl as Catalog Estimate with no service error.
